Method of Attack: StarJacking technique on PyPI to link to a popular GitHub project and install WASP Stealer malware
Impacted Systems: Hosts running the malicious Python packages, victims' Discord accounts, passwords, credit cards, cryptocurrency wallets, and files
Attack Vector: Malicious Python packages on PyPI linked from Discord server and GitHub repository
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Python packages with code modifications to install WASP Stealer malware
